d: Palazzo d'Elaísa, on the left, with stairway. The atrium, and the upper apartments are arranged as a night party. Avenues to the right. The front of the scene presents a pavilion. In the beach of the sea. Music of dance from the palace. Boats to the beach. Gentlemen who wander; then Viscardo, in the end Manfredo and Brunoro.
Elaysa with Damigelle from the avenues, in the same moment Viscardo.
Shady avenues, lighted with pale lights. Viscardo and Brunoro.
Brunoro, then Elaisa from the opposite side from where Viscardo left.

Bianca's room in Manfredo's palace. Tables with twins with bright lights. A harp. Sofa and chairs. A verone that offers sea view. Side doors. Large door in the prospect. Dame in conversation. Some sessions playing, others talking, two with Isaura, pointing to Bianca sitting on the verone.
Bianca and Isaura.
White, from a box of ebony, on the table, picks up a book, carries it out, concentrates, looks at the sky.
Brunoro from the door to the left, nods Viscardo to enter.
Bianca and Viscardo hiding.
Elaisa from the door to the left, with a lamp in her hand. The light just turned off comes out, so she sees Bianca on the sofa.
From the door to the right is Viscardo moving away from Isaura, who tries to hold him, Elaisa and Bianca.
The great middle door is opened, and Manfredo is introduced; after him two Shields and six Guards, who remain outside the door, from which there is a room of arms.
Gentlemen's Choir, Dignitaries, and Guards that are arranged in the hall.

To the left is Manfredo's palace. Guards at the door and other Sentinels around. To the right temple, various shops, and tents in the bottom, which serve as a wine sale. Soldier's bodies that return to their neighborhoods. Citizens with daggers and swords, Artieri with weapons, Populars, Fishers. Soldiers, who to various groups discourse, advance and join in a
Viscardo, on the side of the temple.
From the palace are heard lamentable voices: then come forth Dame and Damigelle desolate, weeping, heading towards the temple.

Remote enclosure adjacent to Manfredo's palace, scattered with cypresses and willows, closed by a high wall with blackbirds, partly covered by an outbuilding. You can see high tombs of the counts of Syracuse. On the left an external part of the temple. A monument to the right leaning against the wall, with bronze door and stairway. Two pedestals with urns. At the monument door, so from the palace enters into the enclosure. The scene is illuminated by sunset. Manfredo exits from the door of the monument to the right. He closes it with key that holds. He stops and looks around.
Voices outside. Manfredo shakes, and opens the door. Gentilums, Dignitarians, Knights armed enter.
After a few moments Elaísa from the great door that restores.
Bianca, in white dress, shows up on the threshold: she observes, then she descends anxiously with surprise and joy. Elaisa aside.
Manfredo, Elaisa, and Bianca.

Room in the palace inhabited by Elaisa. An alcove in prospect closed by coltrinaggio. Two side doors. A large window, chairs, coffee table. Elaìsa with loose hair, sitting at a coffee table on which a lampstand, with bright lights, two bags and a small chest. Her butler at the other side of the table.
The door opens on the left: Viscard enters in a lost, threatening air, and closes.
